text_block_list.text:
With the opening address concluded,<n>the Fan Fest
begins in earnest.<n>Symboli Rudolf's big moment
will be<n>the exhibition race at the end of the<n>event.

Despite technically being a<n>ceremonial race, it's
certain to be<n>competitive. If possible, I'd like her to
spend the morning resting up, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So, in short, the carrot-picking event is<n>struggling
for attendees?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It looks like the<n>scavenger hunt
behind it is getting all<n>of the attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That won't be very encouraging for<n>the students
running it. What other<n>large events are on at the
moment?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Um... well, there's the cosplay race.<n>It's out on the
school track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's relatively close by. We can try<n>funneling
attendees to the carrot<n>picking event from there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's extend the time we have<n>posted for it as
well. I'll give Team G<n>permission to make the
changes.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text: Roger that, President! I'll do that right<n>away!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: Seems like you've got a lot on your plate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I should know better than<n>to sigh like
that in public.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I should not be making you look<n>after me,
either. Go on, look around.<n>Explore.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The students have put their all into<n>making this
festival as good as it can<n>be. I want as many
people as<n>possible to enjoy themselves.

Much as I'd love to enjoy the<n>festival, it's hard
not to worry when<n>she looks so tired.

Not that it's much of a surprise. The<n>combination
of training, student<n>council duties, and planning the
festival has been running her ragged.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, President. Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove. How can I help you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I sent a you request for additional<n>resources a little
while ago, but I<n>never received a reply.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, it slipped my mind.<n>Your request
is approved. You may go<n>ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. And sorry for the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a blunder. I hardly deserve to<n>call myself
president...
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're not just tired?
Are you sure you're not just tired?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps so, but the failure is still<n>mine. If I cannot
look after my own<n>well-being, what good am I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I must pull myself together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The spectators at the exhibition race<n>are expecting
to see me at full<n>strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A great number of students will filter<n>in after the
other races finish as well.<n>I have to show them a
performance<n>worthy of the Emperor.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're going to be all right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Never fear. I'm always all right,<n>am I not?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, go ahead and enjoy the Fan<n>Fest. I need to
return to the student<n>council office to receive some
more<n>reports.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The event continues smoothly thanks<n>to the
efforts of the student council,<n>but I can't quite
shake a lingering<n>sense of unease.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the event you've<n>all been
waiting for: the Tracen<n>Academy exhibition race!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, all eyes are on the<n>Emperor,
Symboli Rudolf! How will<n>she rule the track today?
The crowd<n>is buzzing with anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Go Rudooolf!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The crowd is more curious abouthow Symboli Rudolf will win, ratherthan whether she'll win... butthat's not how things pan out.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
And we're coming into the final<n>stretch... but it
looks like Symboli<n>Rudolf is having some trouble!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
There's someone coming up on the<n>outside, but
it's not Symboli Rudolf!<n>It's—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
What the heck was that? Isn't she<n>supposed to
be the Emperor?

text_block_list.name: Spectating Student
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen the President run so<n>slow... What
happened?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Symboli Rudolf never<n>manages to
separate herself from the<n>pack. It's a
disappointing<n>performance for the Emperor, and
the<n>crowd knows it.
